steps.code:
# Now let's import all markdown files as notes in Simple Note.
# For each file, get content, derive title from filename (basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces), and create note.
import os

for file_path in files:
    # Get file content
    file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_info['content']
    
    # Derive title from filename
    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    # Remove .md extension
    if basename.endswith('.md'):
        basename = basename[:-3]
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    title = basename.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note in Simple Note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        access_token=sn_token,
        title=title,
        content=content
    )
    print(f"Created note: {title} -> {result}")

for file_path in files:

    content = file_info['content']
    
    # Derive title from filename
    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    # Remove .md extension
    if basename.endswith('.md'):
        basename = basename[:-3]
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    title = basename.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note in Simple Note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        access_token=sn_token,
        title=title,
        content=content
    )
    print(f"Created note: {title} -> {result}")
